places: National Day (Ugyen WANGCHUCK became first hereditary king)

fields.climate: varies; tropical in southern plains; cool winters and hot summers in central valleys; severe winters and cool summers in Himalayas
fields.terrain: mostly mountainous with some fertile valleys and savanna
fields.hazards: violent storms from the Himalayas are the source of the country's Bhutanese name, which translates as Land of the Thunder Dragon; frequent landslides during the rainy season
fields.farm: rice, milk, potatoes, root vegetables, maize, oranges, areca nuts, chillies/peppers, pumpkins/squash, carrots/turnips
fields.exports: iron alloys, aircraft, dolomite, semi-finished iron, cement
fields.industries: cement, wood products, processed fruits, alcoholic beverages, calcium carbide, tourism
fields.languages: Sharchopkha 28%, Dzongkha (official) 24%, Lhotshamkha 22%, other 26% (includes foreign languages)
fields.religions: Lamaistic Buddhist 75.3%, Indian- and Nepali-influenced Hinduism 22.1%, other 2.6%

independence.event: became a unified kingdom under its first hereditary king

fields.legal: civil law based on Buddhist religious law

holiday.name: National Day (Ugyen WANGCHUCK became first hereditary king)

fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; militia training is compulsory for men aged 20-25 over a 3-year period
